title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
summary: An orphan mistreated by her relatives and at a harsh school becomes a governess at Thornfield Hall. She grows close to its brooding master, Mr Rochester, while odd things happen in the night.
readIf: you like gothic romance with a strong-minded, independent heroine.
skipIf: you dislike Victorian pacing or long religious and moral passages.

pairings.reason: Another gothic romance about a young woman in a grand, mysterious house and a brooding man.
The darker, wilder sister novel, with a love that is closer to obsession.
A gentler tale of an orphan sent to a Yorkshire house with secrets.
